reviews.text: Ordering poolside with Camelback Mountain as the backdrop makes this place the cat's meow! The setting is just stunning, as you take in the views and relaxing poolside,  Their specialty Phoenician Iced Tea was a tasty treat and really hit the spot on a warm afternoon. We were there for a late lunch, and I was starving so I got their Kalio Burger. This burger was worth every penny and was so AMAZING! It was full of flavor and the fries were perfect, even with poolside service, which makes service more difficult. They dona great job and service was fast and friendly.
reviews.author: Shawn V.

reviews.text: On my trip, the poolside meal was the worse meal I had all week.  It was my only meal at Phoenician. Chips were greasy, quac was flavorless and chicken Caesar wrapped in was underwhelming. I should have sent it back on the first bite but we tried to muscle through eating and only ate 1/2.  Disappointing.
reviews.author: C H.

reviews.text: I came down to the pool on a Thursday afternoon and it wasn't packed but there are enough chairs around for enough people so there's plenty of room for everyone. The food was excellent. Our poolside server was Marissa who was absolutely great and continued to check on us while we were here. For pool side food it's very good!
reviews.author: Reagan W.

reviews.text:
Spent the day at the pool before our spa treatments and needed something to hold us over until dinner. It was crazy hot so I didn't want anything heavy. I opted for the greek salad with a chicken kabob. It was just what I wanted. 

I ordered at the bar. I stood there for a while before someone from the kitchen came out and asked if I needed anything. The bar staff were very busy and perhaps they're not at all involved in food orders but they didn't know that's what I was there for. One particular bartender walked by me at least 3x and didn't even acknowledge me. A simple hello or I'll be with you shortly would have sufficed. Nothing. 

The smiling young man who imerged from the kitchen was wonderful. He asked what I needed, promptly took my order and told me to come back in about 10 min. After that everything was smooth sailing. I charged to the room. The bartender who ignored me was the one who had me sign for my bill when I came back and she was attentive then which is the only reason I'm giving 4 not 3 stars. 

Food was great. My salad was filled with fresh ingredients. Kalmata olives, shredded cheese, tomato, thin sliced cucumber & red onion, some type of green sauce on the side. It might have been a pesto tabouli mixture. It was good! The skewer came with 2 juicy grilled pieces of chicken with a flavorful sauce on it. Came with some thin crunchy tortilla chips too. 


Here's my review in a nutshell. Was it over priced? Yes? Do you expect that @ the pool at a hotel? You should. Was it tasty? Yes. Would I get it again, definitely. Was the service top notch? Almost. Bar staff could use a few shots of friendliness towards people who come to the bar. I get they're busy. But being completely ignored makes you feel like you're a burden. A quick, be right with you goes far.
reviews.author: Melissa D.

reviews.text:
This is the pool restaurant. We ate lunch there five times during our vacation and liked every meal! The portions are large - plenty for two of us. If the food was supposed to be hot, it was HOT! This is where we also got some good cocktails. Even on the busiest days, it didn't take long to get our food.
We've eaten at a fair number of pool restaurants at resorts and this was probably the best. 
The staff were also great! I have absolutely no idea how many people work there, but they are all constantly hustling!
I highly recommend  checking it out!
reviews.author: Melanie B.

reviews.text: We are staying at the Phoenician and came down to eat while our room was being cleaned. By far the best resort pool food I've tasted! I had the salmon kabobs and it was delicious. The accompaniments were perfectly balanced and refreshing. The Mediterranean menu hit the spot! My husband had the wrap and was able to sub the cucumber salad for fries. Good portion size. Mint lemonade was sweet, refreshing and, light. Fantastic service too. Samantha and Kwasi took care of us. This is a lunch to remember!
reviews.author: Mary E.

reviews.text: Great service, awesome drinks and amazing staff. Super chill vibes and you can't beat the view. Grab a sipper and chill by the pool and enjoy the vibes.  The chicken kabobs were on point. I can't wait to come back.
reviews.author: Tony G.

reviews.text:
Every hotel I've stayed at regardless of how fancy or simple, has had one thing in common - the pool food has always sucked. It's usually overpriced and highly unimpressive; therefore, I do what I can to avoid eating by the pool. Given prior experiences, I really did not expect much when I ordered the Pacific Shrimp Kebob platter at Kalio... First bite, and I could not believe my tastebuds! Every single element of the dish was executed perfectly, from the most scrumptious jalapeño salsa to the fresh still warm naan bread to the perfectly seasoned and cooked shrimp itself... It was delicious and I could not get enough. 

I've only eaten there once, so can't comment on consistency/reliability, but that lunch blew me away in a very unexpected way. Highly recommend as a lunch option if you're spending your afternoon by the Phoenician pool. Two thumbs up for the Kabobery!!!
reviews.author: Daria A.

reviews.text: Super nice young lady at the counter. Kale salad was a bummer though. It was tough and came with a mayo-type dressing. I ended up going back to get a pourable dressing. Cool place, but maybe try a sandwich or burger.
reviews.author: Larissa B.

reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician and ordered a lot of drinks and lunch from this restaurant while enjoying the pool. 
One day we got the chicken shawarma kabob pictured. They bring it out in these plastic platters which is great for eating poolside to keep it all contained and not have to worry about flimsy plates. The dish was perfect for sharing between 2 people since it comes with pita and sides. I really liked the pita and dipping sauces. 
The service was amazing with the servers walking around to take orders and the food runners bringing everything out. They'll even take drink orders while you're in the pool so you can keep relaxing. It was also nice to be able to charge everything to the room and not having to worry about cash and credit cards at the pool.
reviews.author: Katie U.

reviews.text:
This cute little outdoor Mediterranean inspired restaurant was a real treat for us on several occasions. It is located over looking the center of the resort and it's beautiful pools. Closets to the kid's pool and the splash pad. There is a nice welcoming bar area. We met so many friendly people here. The employees are welcoming and pleasantly accommodate any needs. We need to avoid gluten and thry were more than helpful making sure the kids had something yummy and safe to eat with no issues. 

The girl's enjoyed Beach Blanket Humus with veggies and ranch. They also liked the Grilled Cabana Chicken Kabobs. Lava Flow kiddie cocktails and Dippin Dots for dessert. My mom amd I had the Prime Kabobs with grilled veggies. Everything made gluten free. Everything tasted great. 

They also have suntan lotion, sunblock, lip balm etc if you forgot to bring yours.
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! Spent the day by the pool and had lunch and drinks from here. I had the lava flow which was essentially a piña colada with a strawberry drizzle and my fiancé had a strawberry daiquiri, both were delicious! We ordered the shrimp kabobs and the baja fish tacos and wow! Some of the best flavors!! A great relaxing experience with great service and food and drink, much recommended!
reviews.author: Kimberly S.

reviews.text: To start off it was pretty easy to see what to do we went to the bar and ordered drinks so good !!! We had the lava flows and hit the spot with all flavors ! Then we layed out and ordered lunch and I got the kabobs shrimp and steak and I tell hands down the best I've ever had and my fiancé got the fish tacos same with hers ! Sarah attended us great and checked up often . The gentlemen helped us with the umbrellas and towels and very good at their job thank you so much for the great day !
reviews.author: Mike W.

reviews.text: Not too bad for pool food. The chips, salsa and guacamole was really good. Fresh and tasty. Kids burgers were good enough for them and kept them happy. Wasn't too keen on the fact that their menu was limited and one day of our stay it was boxed food which was very over priced. That is the reason for 4 stars. Maybe next time their menu will be more robust and served full time.
reviews.author: Michael S.
